writeup: Mountain Hardwear's Ghost Whisperer hoody is an ultralight 800-fill RDS-certified down jacket that stuffs into its own pocket. Woot has the men's small new for $73.99, while Steep & Cheap charges $215.99 and Public Lands $269.99 for the same jacket. That's about 65% below the cheapest store we found, with only a handful left.
